selection.title: Batch targets
selection.what: Selects the saved circuits included in this batch preview.
selection.how: Review each selected circuit; saving a batch does not start acquisition.

signed.title: Allow negative increments
signed.what: Declares signed counter semantics for this saved measurement.
signed.how: Use only when the source permits negative increments. Signed counters cannot use the rollover policy.

modulus.title: Rollover modulus
modulus.what: The exact positive modulus used to interpret a counter wrap.
modulus.how: Optional positive decimal text, at most 64 characters. No exponent notation; signed or floating counters cannot use it.
modulus.example: 65536 only for a documented modulo-65536 counter.

rate.title: Maximum rate per second
rate.what: Bounds plausible counter growth when evaluating rollover.
rate.how: Optional positive decimal text, at most 64 characters, requiring a modulus. Do not infer it from a sample.
rate.example: 100 only when the source specification supports that limit.

mode.title: Switch direction
mode.what: Chooses a forward switch or rollback of an existing switch.
mode.how: Review source, destinations and boundary before applying; this can change which recording runs.

source.title: Source recording
source.what: The saved recording whose active sources will switch.
source.how: Only eligible saved records are offered; a name alone does not grant ownership.

target.title: Target recordings
target.what: The prepared saved destinations for the selected source scope.
target.how: Select eligible long-format targets and review the exact effect before applying.

rollback.title: Previous switch
rollback.what: Identifies the prior switch eligible for rollback.
rollback.how: Choose the exact recorded operation and review its boundary and started targets.
rollback.example: The operation at the intended recorded boundary.

boundary.title: Switch boundary
boundary.what: The requested local date and time for a reviewed switch.
boundary.how: The existing converter sends an instant; the server-reviewed boundary remains authoritative. Review before applying.
boundary.example: A future local time agreed for the switch.

interval.title: Acquisition interval
interval.what: How often this device reads all of its points.
interval.how: Enter 100 to 3,600,000 ms; after saving, this device's own polling group uses it.

autoInterval.title: Automatic interval adjustment
autoInterval.what: Stretches the interval actually used when scans take longer than the configured interval.
autoInterval.how: When on, the interval steps back toward the configured value after scans stay on time; the effective value is shown below.
autoInterval.example: Configured 500 ms with 700 ms scans stretches the effective value.

staleThreshold.title: Stale threshold
staleThreshold.what: How long a point may go without a successful read before a stale anomaly is recorded.
staleThreshold.how: Enter milliseconds above 0; leave empty for the default (interval x5, at least 10 seconds).
staleThreshold.example: 5000 records an anomaly after 5 seconds without a successful read.

frozenThreshold.title: Frozen value threshold
frozenThreshold.what: Reads succeed but the value never changes; after this time a frozen anomaly is recorded.
frozenThreshold.how: Enter 0 or more milliseconds; 0 disables it.
frozenThreshold.example: 600000 records it after 10 minutes without any change.

profile.title: Acquisition optimization profile
profile.what: Declares which read methods the PLC supports, so the system can decide whether random reads may merge scattered addresses.
profile.how: Choose a profile only when the PLC model is confirmed; if unsure keep undeclared or safe-v1, which use safe contiguous reads.
profile.example: Choose mitsubishi-q-iqr-3e-binary-v1 for a Q/iQ-R CPU.

randomPoints.title: Random point limit
randomPoints.what: The most points one random read request may contain.
randomPoints.how: Defaults to the protocol limit (MC 192, FATEK 64 weighted words) and can only be lowered; larger sets are split into several requests.
randomPoints.example: Lower it to 120 when the PLC responds slowly.

contiguous.title: Contiguous block aggregation
contiguous.what: Modbus merges points with adjacent addresses into one read.
contiguous.how: No profile is needed; keeping point addresses contiguous reduces the number of requests.
contiguous.example: 40001–40010 are read in a single request.
